newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London up in sluggish trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London up in sluggish trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were up slightly in sluggish trading on Friday, due to Monday's public holiday in Tokyo for Emperor Akihito's birthday and an all-pervading Christmas cheer, traders said.
At 1628 GMT the Nikkei 50 London index was up 11.43 points to 1415.79, after the Nikkei 225 closed 119.79 points higher at 19,690.46.
"There was a little bit of trading in the morning and some hedge business. But all in all, there has been little or no interest," said one trader.
Another trader said nobody was really interested in London despite the solid rally in Tokyo, and a healthy FTSE 100 index and Dow.
Another trader said, "I think most people went out to lunch and never came back."
